instruction: You are a strategic corporate innovation advisor conducting a reassessment. Analyse the prior assessment summary, changes since last assessment, and updated survey, then respond with a complete reassessment JSON including score_delta, carry_forward, progress, and comparison_to_previous.

answers.companyDescription: Adventure tourism operator specializing in guided hiking, canyoning, and rock climbing experiences across 3 national parks. 25 certified guides leading 4,000 clients annually. Seeking to streamline booking and safety waiver management with a mobile-first platform. A growing organization that has moved past founder-led decision-making but is still building the formal processes and governance structures needed to scale. We have some digital tools in place but integration between systems is ad-hoc. Innovation is championed by 1-2 internal advocates.
answers.pastInitiatives: We installed IoT sensors on 40% of our production equipment to monitor utilization and predict failures. The pilot showed a 15% reduction in unplanned downtime on instrumented machines. We now have a business case approved for full fleet rollout, but procurement and integration with our legacy maintenance system are proving more complex than anticipated.
answers.strategicGoals: Targeting 30% year-over-year top-line growth. We see untapped demand in adjacent customer segments and are evaluating whether to build, buy, or partner to accelerate market penetration. The core question is whether to deepen our vertical specialization or broaden horizontally into related product categories.
answers.teamSize: The innovation function is informal — one senior engineer has been given permission to spend 20% of their time exploring new technologies and prototyping ideas, but this allocation is frequently interrupted by production incidents and urgent feature requests. We have no dedicated innovation budget beyond standard cloud infrastructure costs.

input.changes_since_last: Product launch successful — 7 new features shipped. Customer NPS improved 20 points. Backlog of technical debt growing.

opportunities.title: Scaling Operational Data Integration from IoT Pilot
opportunities.rationale: The successful pilot of IoT sensors provides a strong business case for operational data utilization. The next step must be integrating this predictive maintenance data not just into the legacy system, but also linking it to resource scheduling and real-time safety management for maximum ROI.

first_actions: Define clear APIs/integration points between IoT platform, CRM, and Booking System.
Develop a centralized operational dashboard focusing on asset utilization vs. guide availability.
Identify the necessary middleware or cloud function layer to handle data normalization and schema mapping.
execution_plan.success_metric: Integration completion score of 80%+ across core operational systems.
milestones: Prototype dashboard linking IoT data to scheduling.
Successful transfer of 5 key data streams (e.g., utilization, failure prediction) into the central system.
Formal adoption and sign-off from Operations leadership.

opportunities.title: Establishing Structured Strategic Portfolio Decision Framework
opportunities.rationale: The internal debate regarding vertical specialization versus horizontal growth is a strategic blocker. Implementing a formal, recurring 'Strategy Forum' will provide the governance needed to evaluate market opportunities against current resource constraints and risk appetite.

first_actions: Define 3-5 quantifiable success criteria (e.g., payback period, required market size) for new ventures.
Develop a weighted decision matrix incorporating competitive pressure, internal capability, and regulatory complexity.
Schedule quarterly 'Strategic Review' meetings with key stakeholders to mandate documented decisions.
resources_needed: Strategy Consulting input or framework template
execution_plan.success_metric: Reduction in strategic ambiguity, evidenced by a documented 12-month portfolio plan approved by leadership.
milestones: Creation and training on the decision matrix.
Successful evaluation of at least two potential market vectors (e.g., adjacent products).
Formal alignment between marketing/product teams based on the defined strategy.

next_steps.action: Formalize and ring-fence protected time for the senior engineer to focus solely on tackling technical debt backlog items identified during the IoT integration process.
Develop and mandate standardized procedures for capturing customer feedback beyond NPS, focusing on 'Why' behind both positive and negative experiences to feed directly into the product roadmap.
Conduct a gap analysis between current staffing structure (guides, support staff) and projected capacity needs derived from the full IoT rollout plan to preemptively address resource bottlenecks.

key_weaknesses: Accumulation of technical debt is hindering scalability and slowing down feature delivery despite product success.
Formal governance mechanisms for strategic decision-making are underdeveloped, leading to internal ambiguity regarding growth direction (vertical vs. horizontal).
The innovation function lacks formal protection—the single dedicated engineer's time remains vulnerable to operational firefighting.

improvements: Achieved significant customer satisfaction improvements (NPS +20 points) following product launches.
Successfully piloted advanced technology (IoT sensors), generating actionable data and a clear business case for large-scale rollout.
Shifted from purely founder-led to having a defined process (albeit nascent) for resource allocation (dedicated engineer time).
persistent_gaps: The integration complexity of new technology with legacy systems remains the primary bottleneck.
Systemic processes and formal governance structures still lag behind operational growth, especially in strategy execution.
Lack of a dedicated, protected innovation budget or resource pool.
achieved_milestones: Successful shipment of 7 new product features.
Approval of business case for full IoT fleet rollout.

comparison_to_previous.key_changes: The company demonstrated measurable execution success (NPS increase, IoT pilot approval) and moved towards defining formal process structures. The primary challenge remains translating operational successes into stable, scalable processes governed by a clear strategy.
